backend/main.mo: Motoko canister defining time entries, media, journals, user profiles, file storage, and access control with persistent maps and role‑based admin functions.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping features to affected files, components, tests, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of major frontend React components, pages, styles, and utilities.
frontend/ANDROID_REGRESSION_CHECKLIST.md: Manual Android Chrome regression testing checklist for icon‑tap crashes, rapid interactions, and debug‑log verification.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML shell loading the React app via main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app orchestrating authentication, profile setup, tab navigation, error boundary usage, and debug logging.
frontend/src/components/DayTypeCheckboxG: Mutually exclusive checkbox-style selector for choosing a day type with animated visual feedback.
frontend/src/components/ErrorBoundary.ts: React error boundary displaying an English recovery UI with reload/go‑back actions and error details.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Simple footer with attribution and branding using a heart icon.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Header component handling login/logout, showing app title, version badge, user greeting, and admin-only publish dialog.
Mobile bottom navigation bar with four tabs that logs tab changes and visually highlights the active tab.
frontend/src/components/PublishRetryDial: Dialog that lets admins trigger a publish workflow restart and displays mutation status alerts.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook that creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor and refreshes dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React context and provider managing Internet Identity authentication, state, and login/logout flows.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks for user profile, admin checks, publish restart, time entries, and related mutations.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining light/dark theme variables and mobile-safe interaction utilities.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry point initializing React, React Query, Internet Identity, and global styles.
frontend/src/pages/Calendar.tsx: Monthly calendar UI with CRUD for time entries, photo/audio attachments, and media recording/upload handling.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Displays aggregated work statistics with charts, filtering by weekly/monthly/yearly periods.
frontend/src/pages/Journal.tsx: Journal entry manager with text, photos, simulated audio transcription, recording, and CRUD operations.
frontend/src/pages/Reports.tsx: Generates weekly or monthly time-entry summaries and prepares data for PDF export.
frontend/src/utils/debugLogging.ts: Simple conditional debug logger for UI interactions with enable/disable controls.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: TailwindCSS config defining themes, colors, animations, and plugin setup for the frontend.
project_state.json: Contains project metadata, architectural notes, and known issues for the TimeTrack web app built on ICP. Describes frontend/backend structure, workflows, integrations, and current technical limitations.
